Four candidates remain: sheep, kangaroo, bat, mouse. I want a question that splits them evenly or close to it.

Option 18 (hopping) separates only the kangaroo, and mouse may also hop. Option 7 (raised on farms) separates only the sheep. Option 15 (fits in hand) separates bat and mouse from sheep and kangaroo, which is a 2/2 split. After that I would still need one more question, then a guess.

A guess now has a 1/4 chance of being right. Asking a question that splits 2/2 and then guessing gives an expected number of turns of 1 + 1 + 0.5 = 2.5 turns, assuming the second step is a guess with a 50% chance. A 3-way split with a single question that isolates one animal would be better. Option 6 (can it fly?) isolates only bat, so it is no better than option 15.

Option 15 is the best choice here.

**15**
